description: This Java class defines Cucumber step definitions for detecting duplicate classpath resources during classpath scans in the project. It uses ClassGraph to scan resources, identify duplicates, and assert that no duplicates are found, excluding known harmless ones.

classes.name: ClasspathDuplicatesStepDefinitions
classes.description: A class containing Cucumber step definitions for scanning classpath resources and detecting duplicates, with logic to ignore certain known harmless duplicates.

methods.name: ClasspathDuplicatesStepDefinitions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Cucumber steps for classpath scanning and duplicate detection.

methods.name: skipJAR
methods.description: Checks if a JAR file path should be skipped based on its location, such as Gradle wrapper or JetBrains.

methods.name: isHarmlessDuplicate
methods.description: Determines if a resource path is a known harmless duplicate to be ignored during duplicate checks.
